title: The rise and fall of david choe a story of art, crime, and comedy

segments.x: hey everyone welcome to my channel where I talk about art and culture today I want to introduce you to one of my favorite artists David Choe he is an American Artist musician actor and former journalist and podcast host from Los Angeles he has a very unique and versatile style that he calls dirty

style which explores themes of Desire degradation and exaltation he has done paintings murals graphic novels magazines documentaries and even podcasts David Choe was born in 1976 to Korean immigrants and born-again Christians he started spray painting on the streets when he was a teenager and dropped out of our school he self-published his first graphic novel

slow jams in 1996 and won a grant to publish a second edition in 1999. he became famous when he painted the walls of Facebook offices in 2005 and 2007 and chose to receive Company stock instead of cash his shares were worth 200 million dollars when Facebook went public in 2012. David Choe has also

traveled around the world and documented his adventures in his online series thumbs up with Vice he hitchhiked and Freight hopped across the U.S China and other countries with his friend Harry Kim he also made an autobiographical documentary called dirty hands the art and crimes of David Choe in 2008. he has been featured in many magazines

Galleries and museums including Hustler Ray Gunn Vice giant robots Jonathan Levine gallery lazarites gallery and the Santa Rosa Museum of Contemporary Arts David Choe is a very controversial and provocative artist who has faced backlash for some of his comments and actions he has admitted to being addicted to gambling sex and drugs he

has also been accused of rape by a massage therapist he allegedly assaulted in 2014 he later apologized for his remarks on his podcast Devi Dasa and said he was joking he is currently starring in a new Netflix comedy series called beef with Steven Yoon that's all for today's video if you want to learn

more about David Choe and his Arts you can check out his website at davidcho.com or follow him on Instagram at a David show thanks for watching and don't forget to like comment and subscribe for more videos like this one
